title: Calculate Quotient and Remainder
question: Read two integers and print their quotient and remainder.
code:
a = int(input("First integer: "))
b = int(input("Second integer: "))
if b != 0:
    print("Quotient:", a // b)
    print("Remainder:", a % b)
else:
    print("Cannot divide by zero")
expected_output:
For inputs 17 and 5:
First integer: 17
Second integer: 5
Quotient: 3
Remainder: 2
explanation: // gives the integer quotient and % gives the remainder. The program checks for zero.
